checks.note: Aura auth page confirms OAuth2 client-credentials: client ID/secret via HTTP Basic to https://api.neo4j.io/oauth/token, 3600s Bearer token. Query API auth page (found via search) confirms Bearer (SSO-issued token) in addition to Basic, so the record's 'not confirmed' caveat on Bearer is now resolved. Basic, OAuth2 and Bearer are all correct.

Auth page states 'All tiers can create Aura API credentials', which covers Free. The overview page only gives the 25 req/min rate limit for Free/trial. The original evidence URL (overview) does not state credential creation, so I moved the evidence to the auth page.

Query API is HTTP/REST at POST /db/<db>/query/v2 (default port 7474). The Aura API is also REST. 'moderate' breadth is not fully verified because the full Aura endpoint list was not retrieved. The record already flags this.

github.com/neo4j/mcp is under the neo4j org and described as 'Neo4j official MCP Server'. It exposes get-schema, read-cypher, write-cypher and list-gds-procedures, and documents username/password config.

ready_with_caveats is consistent. Two separate surfaces (Aura management vs per-database Query API). The Query API supports Bearer/SSO tokens, so the blocker's 'No OAuth for end-user delegation' should be softened: tokens come from your own SSO provider. Rate limits 25/125 req/min confirmed.

corrected.one_liner: Neo4j is a graph database queried with Cypher, offered self-managed and as the managed AuraDB cloud service.
corrected.auth_notes: Two separate surfaces. (1) Aura management API (api.neo4j.io): client ID/secret created in the Aura console, exchanged at /oauth/token (client_credentials, HTTP Basic) for a 1-hour Bearer token. This is a machine-to-machine client-credentials flow, not a third-party-app consent flow. (2) Query API (HTTP, /db/<db>/query/v2) to run Cypher: requires an Authorization header; accepts Basic (database user/password) or Bearer tokens issued by your own SSO provider. The official MCP server documents only username/password.
corrected.access_notes: AuraDB Free exists, and the Aura API auth page states 'All tiers can create Aura API credentials'. Free and Pro trial without billing are rate-limited to 25 req/min. Self-managed Community Edition is also free and exposes the Query API.
corrected.blocker: No single API: the Aura API only manages instances (and billing); data access goes through the Query API or Bolt against a specific database, using that database's credentials (Basic) or an SSO-issued Bearer token. No third-party-app OAuth consent flow. Aura API rate limit is 25 req/min on free/trial, 125 on paid. Full Aura endpoint list was not retrieved.
